record.context_brief: Ranks of abelian varieties over Qab
record.original_question: For every non-zero abelian variety A defined over Q, is the Mordell-Weil rank of A over Qab infinite; that is, does rank(A(Qab)) = infinity hold for every such A?

evidence.quote: Question 3.2 (Frey-Jarden). Is rank(A(Qab)) = infinity for every non-zero abelian variety A over Q?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}}$ denote the maximal abelian extension of $\mathbb{Q}$, i.e., the compositum of all finite abelian Galois extensions of $\mathbb{Q}$ inside a fixed algebraic closure (equivalently, by the Kronecker–Weber theorem, the field obtained by adjoining all roots of unity to $\mathbb{Q}$). For an abelian variety $A$ defined over $\mathbb{Q}$, the Mordell–Weil group $A(\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}})$ is an abelian group whose rank is $\dim_{\mathbb{Q}} A(\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}}) \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} \mathbb{Q}$.

Question: Is it true that for every non-zero abelian variety $A$ defined over $\mathbb{Q}$, the rank of $A(\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}})$ is infinite?
artifact.status_search_result: The Frey–Jarden question (posed 1974) is known in several cases: for elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$ (Frey–Jarden), for Jacobians of curves with infinitely many rational points, and for abelian varieties of GL_2-type with trivial character. The general case for arbitrary abelian varieties over $\mathbb{Q}$ remains open as of recent literature.

status_evidence.title: The Rank of Jacobian Varieties over the Maximal Abelian Extensions of Number Fields: Towards the Frey–Jarden Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Affirmative answers to the Frey–Jarden conjecture for Jacobians of curves with infinitely many rational points, and for abelian varieties of GL_2-type with trivial character.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture established in further partial cases beyond elliptic curves; general case remains a conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Ranks of abelian varieties over infinite extensions of the rationals
status_evidence.snippet: Frey and Jarden proved infinite rank for elliptic curves over Q over Qab; the general statement is a conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Known for elliptic curves; general abelian varieties over Q is open.
